name: br4-multiplayer
description: Modern multiplayer stack for Burnin' Rubber 4 (Shockwave/Director): online races + free roam with chat.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @br4mp/protocol && npm run build -w @br4mp/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @br4mp/protocol && npm run typecheck -w @br4mp/server
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test packages/protocol/dist/test/*.test.js packages/server/dist/test/*.test.js
